name: BBEH
description: Big-Bench Extra Hard — per-task prompt optimization against exact-match scoring. Routes through TermNorm /matches with the llm_only pipeline.

llm_only.description: Direct LLM generation on the TermNorm backend. No dataset-side max_tokens cap — provider ceiling applies. reasoning_effort=low so the reasoning trace stays clear of Groq's per-model output ceiling on small models (the BBEH 'Extra Hard' puzzles otherwise burn the budget before any visible token emerges; see datasets/bbeh/task_description.md).
